name: Carolyn Mendoza
bioParagraphs: Carolyn Mendoza serves as a Property Sales Associate at Soluna Realty Group
and first-time investors find the right property across reputable real estate developers in the Philippines
and other trusted developers.  Her focus is on making the property-buying process clear
and pressure-free — guiding clients through reservation procedures
and turnover timelines so they know exactly what to expect at every stage.  Whether it's a house-and-lot community for a growing family
a premium condominium for a young professional
or an investment property with long-term potential
Carolyn takes the time to match each client with the right development and payment plan based on their budget
